name: GOV.UK Design System
fit: Public services that need a small, tested, accessible set.
principles: Simplicity, evidence from user research, and accessibility. Text and interactive elements meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast. A component can be experimental until the source marks it stable.
color: Use functional roles, not copied hex: text, secondary-text, inverse-text, link, link-hover, link-visited, link-active, border, input-border, body-background, template-background, focus, focus-text, error, success, hover, brand, surface-background, surface-text, and surface-border. Focus yellow is only for keyboard focus. A palette of named groups (blue, green, teal, purple, magenta, red, orange, yellow, brown, black, white) with tint and shade variants is for illustration and custom components, through the colour function.
spacing: Two scales, units 0 through 9. Static spacing is the same on every screen. Responsive spacing matches it above the 640px tablet breakpoint and is tighter below that, except units 0 through 3, which never change. Use the spacing helpers.
components: Service patterns that have been tested with users. Prefer a published component over a custom one.
adapt: Keep the functional colour roles, the spacing units, and the tested-pattern habit. Replace GOV.UK blue, the focus yellow, and the Transport type unless this product is a public service.
